analysis_md:
解析：

$P=e^{-(x^2-y^2)}\cos 2xy，\quad Q=e^{-(x^2-y^2)}\sin 2xy，$

$$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=e^{-(x^2-y^2)}[(-2x\sin 2xy+2y\cos 2xy)-(2y\cos 2xy-2x\sin 2xy)]=0$$
